notes: CDER sterile-manufacturing CGMP letter based on a 704(a)(4) records review (no on-site inspection) of an OTC isopropyl alcohol (IPA) prep pad manufacturer: the QU did not demonstrate the manufacturing process renders the product, labeled as sterile, actually sterile, plus missing active-ingredient release testing and missing component identity/DEG-EG/methanol testing. The product is described only by the generic descriptor 'isopropyl alcohol (IPA) prep pad drug products,' not a proprietary name, so products is empty; it is not (b)(4)-redacted, so product_redacted is false. No organism, contamination, or recall language is stated. location_contains is 'Jiaxing, Zhejiang' (the city/province pair immediately preceding the postal code in the facility address), a judgment call since the more specific 'TongXiang City' sits between Chongfu Town and Jiaxing in that address.
